rca of the issue: The branding sweep updated the 7 hot-spot files but missed (a) two nav labels that reference the Rewards module by human-facing name in the profile shells, and (b) the accompanying regression test file which hardcoded the old '[BAKED]' subject prefix. Root cause: the sweep was file-scoped rather than token-scoped. Mitigation: run `grep -rn 'MARTbaked\|SENDbaked\|baked Rewards\|\[BAKED\]' /app --include='*.py' --include='*.js' --include='*.jsx'` and address every result that is user-visible text or an assertion on user-visible text.
